notes.title: v1.1.4 - [LOTS OF SMALL FIXES]
notes.notes:
Aloha!
Here’s a small Sunstone War patch note for v1.1.4!
I've uploaded several updates recently but hadn’t taken the time to write a proper patch note—so here it is!

[b]v1.1.4 - [LOTS OF SMALL FIXES][/b]

[b][CONTROLS] [/b]Add an aim input to lock the cursor while moving.
[b][DESIGN][/b] Adjusted level 12's design to reduce the number of enemies.
[b][FIX][/b] In the Level Selection: level 19 now uses the correct 1st biome art instead of the 2nd biome art.
[b][FIX][/b] Plain Power being available on every level instead of once every 3 levels.
[b][FIX][/b] Some Steam Achievements triggers when they shouldn't.
[b][TUTORIAL][/b] Update the tutorial to include aim input.
[b][TYPO][/b] Fixed typos in the French localization thanks to [b]@Bestio[/b]

If you encounter any bugs or weird behavior, feel free to reply to this patch note.
I'll do my best to fix the issues as quickly as possible!

Thanks a lot for your help and support,

Best regards,
Blukulélé

notes.title: The prologue of the tower defense action game Sunstone War is now available!
notes.notes:
Can you imagine that you could carry EVERYTHING in a tower defense game? Move towers, toss away enemies, carry obstacles, upgrade skills and journey through lands to protect your village from calamity!

The prologue of Sunstone War is now available, featuring 10 carefully designed levels for players to challenge, spanning across three distinct areas: grasslands, Thunder Plains, and volcanoes. Each level boasts unique monsters, obstacles, and mechanics, ensuring you'll enjoy this highly distinctive tower defense game.

Welcome to go to Steam to experience Sunstone War - Prologue, and add the full version into your wishlist!

Steam link to Sunstone War - Prologue: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3171310/_/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444791/da9178df80d554c54798db54bb777197223d2874.jpg[/img]

In "Sunstone War - Prologue", you can lift any interactive item, including defensive towers, barriers, and even enemies. You can experience the joy of being overwhelmed and the freedom you have never had before in this tower defense game. No longer do you have to sit around waiting for enemies to attack!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444791/6b9172a59eda355e9926eba02f537f5c52cb7d8f.jpg[/img]

Included in Sunstone War:
- 5-8 hours of play time.
- A "busy" tower defense where you will need to be active to win.
- 60+ challenging levels, each testing your tactical prowess.

NOT included in Sunstone War:
- Static and Classic Tower Defense mechanics
- Infinite replayability

Get ready to embark on an epic journey filled with strategic depth, thrilling action, and the relentless pursuit of victory in Sunstone War!

notes.title: Thanks for your feedbacks!
notes.notes:
Here are the various small changes we've made based on your feedback!

[h2]Map Readability[/h2]
Some players mentioned having trouble identifying the starting and ending points of enemies.
To address this, @CyrolisDev and I added small visual elements to better indicate the paths enemies will take!
At the start, a white smoke indicates where the enemies will appear.
At the end, the defense point is highlighted for better readability!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444791/01b6e366ceb2fdef6187b33ad207ed8089329875.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444791/3f30e3cfe848725fd7fe41276323a580c799705d.png[/img]

[h2]Enemy Readability[/h2]
Some players had difficulty distinguishing between different enemies.
@CyrolisDev has reworked their visuals to make them more easily distinguishable at a glance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444791/e501213237a64823593f8f79b78ce7da2030c45d.png[/img]

[h2]Controller Controls[/h2]
Some players complained about the controller controls, making the game frustrating at times because they couldn't precisely perform the actions they wanted.
I have paid particular attention to this over the past two weeks and, after several playtests, I am very happy with the feedback. I hope you will like it too!


Thanks for reading, and see you soon!

Blukulélé
